evidenceBasis.classic.m7: round 1 (41001-41400, STD 51.75%): BASE 61.5% reproduces STOP; M7_A 0.7/0.6 57.8, M7_B 0.65/0.55 60.3, M7_C 0.6/0.5 58.25 (only 0.1 aggression away from M7_D), all differences to BASE include 0. Knob study (25001-25400, std 54.75%): K +11.5 (risk +9.0, aggression +2.5; aggression-neutral alone 66.5 vs full 67.25), content C +1.0 (not detected); m7 content with std knobs (NEUTRAL) 55.75%. => M7_D is the only evidence-backed candidate; realistic expectation about 53-58% on this block (not a sure qualifier). M7_E keeps the 0.85/0.85 knobs and is a content probe not expected to qualify; M7_F - M7_D measures the stance increment on top of std knobs
evidenceBasis.classic.m8: round 1: BASE 41.0% reproduces WARN weak; M8_A 0.4/0.35 +1.5, M8_B (+jungle gank) -1.0, both include 0. Knob study: m8 knobs with std content 36.5%, m8 content with std knobs 43.25%, full m8 36.25%, std 54.75% => low knobs and the defensive content are substitutes (either alone makes it weak; interaction +11.3). A knob-only step to 0.5 / 0.5 is therefore expected near 43% (borderline) and each content arm adds one content group on top of it to locate the content share. The jungle / tempo group is the largest gank-rate difference (jungle farm gankIntervalK 1.35 x tempo slow 58 s ~ 78 s vs std 45 s), so it is screened as its own group (M8_G)

STD.why: control; must be within 0.50 +/- 0.05 (instrument sanity, as G-A8)

BASE_classic.m7.why: unchanged; reproduction on fresh seeds and the paired baseline of the m7 candidates

M3_C_rep.why: the round-1 selection, re-estimated on fresh seeds (descriptive; the selection rule is applied and reported but never replaces the round-1 selection; a result >= 0.57 is reported to the Owner as a risk for the confirmatory run)

M7_D.why: listed first: the evidence-backed candidate (NEUTRAL 55.75% vs std 54.75% on the G-A8 seeds). Keeps every m7 content field (aggressive lanes, invading jungle, fast tempo, early aggressive stance, invade priority 0.8), so the name and copy direction survive; the risk label and indicator bars move to medium

M7_E.why: content probe, NOT expected to qualify (keeps the 0.85/0.85 knobs that carry K +11.5): the early-game stance is the field the name (early suppression) names; listed second because it contradicts the name more than M7_D

M7_F.why: M7_D plus the stance; can be selected only if M7_D is not inside 0.45-0.55 (the rule takes the first listed candidate inside 0.45-0.55, else the first inside 0.43-0.57); F - D is reported next to the selection

M8_C.why: the larger knob step named in the round-1 plan (knobs back to std); expected near 43% from the knob study (NEUTRAL)

M8_D.why: M8_C plus one content group: support protect -> standard (roamK 0.5 -> 1, protectHp 0.7 -> 0.55). Content arms are ordered by how much of the m8 player copy they contradict, least first: the copy never mentions the support

M8_E.why: M8_C plus tower priority 0.35 -> 0.5 (siegeBias -0.15 -> 0 and the lane offset term); contradicts the cons line that early towers are conceded

M8_F.why: M8_C plus early-game stance defensive -> standard (phaseEngage / phaseJoin early term 0); contradicts the detail line (steady early defence)

M8_G.why: review round 2 #4: M8_C plus the jungle / tempo group (jungle farm -> gank, tempo slow -> standard: gankIntervalK 1.35 -> 1, gankInterval 58 -> 45 s, gank weights no longer x0.4), the largest gank-rate difference to std; the desc (steady development) supports farming, so it is ranked after F

M8_H.why: M8_C plus lane positions defensive -> standard on the three solo / carry lanes (laneOffset -0.05 -> 0 each; one content group); contradicts the most copy (the whole team plays back), listed last (renamed from M8_G on review round 2 when the jungle / tempo arm was inserted before it)

candidateRules: every numeric value stays inside the range the eight classic templates and three overlays already cover (template rule 1); enum values are existing values
the resolved engine knobs of every candidate differ from every other template's resolved knobs and from every other candidate (template rule 3)
only the declared fields differ from the template (V2)
thresholds: the G-A8 rules, unchanged: STOP = win rate >= 0.60 and lower 95% bound > 0.55; WARN strong >= 0.57; WARN weak <= 0.43; control 0.50 +/- 0.05
selectionRule: unchanged from round 1: a candidate qualifies only inside the band 0.43 < win rate < 0.57 for both kinds (an overshoot to the other WARN side never qualifies)
SELECTED: the first qualifying candidate in the listed order with 0.45 <= win rate <= 0.55; a qualifying candidate only in 0.43-0.45 or 0.55-0.57 => SELECTED_BORDERLINE; none => NO_CANDIDATE
listed order: m7 D, E, F; m8 C, D, E, F, G, H (reasons in each arm's why); the order is fixed before the run and is not re-ordered after seeing results; order only matters when two candidates qualify

a template whose BASE arm has no flag on these seeds gets NOT_REPRODUCED (the screened candidate is still reported). For classic.m8 a NOT_REPRODUCED on this block alone does not withdraw the committed G-A8 WARN (round-1 base 41.0, knob study 36.25); the confirmatory G-A8 decides

the selection is a proposal for the Owner, not a fix; selected values must be confirmed by the full confirmatory G-A8 on the reserved seeds 43001-43400 with the original thresholds after one Owner-approved versioned change (TEMPLATE_BALANCE v21.b1, v21 rulesets only)

classic.m3 is in descriptiveOnly: the selection rule is NOT applied; M3_C_rep is reported with verdict DESCRIPTIVE_REPLICATION, selected null, a replicationFlag (RISK_FOR_CONFIRMATORY if >= 0.57, OVERSHOOT if <= 0.45, else CONSISTENT) and its confirmatory risk; it never replaces or confirms the round-1 selection
report: per arm: win rate, 95% CI, G-A8 label, blue / red halves, STANDARD / SWAPPED split, median duration; paired difference to STD for every arm

per candidate: paired difference to its BASE arm with 95% CI; for the arms listed in compareTo also the paired difference to that arm (descriptive content-share estimate for m8, stance increment for m7)
per template: reproduction status of BASE vs the committed G-A8 label, verdict and selected / screened candidate
pooled with round 1 (descriptive only, never used for selection): STD and BASE m3 / m7 / m8 over 800 seeds with 95% CI
multiplicity: 14 arms on one seed block (m8 has six candidates); intervals are unadjusted 95%

confirmatory risk for every candidate: the probability of >= 0.57 or <= 0.43 on 400 confirmatory seeds if the screening estimate were the true rate (normal approximation; winner's curse makes the real risk larger for a selected arm)

validation.V1: the STD and every BASE arm on the first 10 screening seeds reproduce the same configs through the binding path (tacticInputOf template with no choices): win and duration identical
validation.V2: every candidate is valid, inside the shipped range, distinct after resolution, and differs from its template only in the declared fields; every compareTo pair names two existing arms of the same template; 14 arms
validation.V3: V3a every candidate resolves to engine knobs that differ from its BASE (non-vacuous); V3a' every compareTo arm differs from its compare target on the v2 probe (the added group reaches the engine); V3b on 2 seeds per candidate the engine t=0 Director values equal the expectation

liveCheck: every record: balanceTool.v21, Director core.v1, laneFrame teamRelative, skills on, talents off, and the t=0 Director probe equals the arm's expectation; any mismatch => HALT
errors: errored matches are never retried; more than 1% errored => STOP(INSTRUMENT)
